description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for user-related operations, including registration, login, profile retrieval, and updates. It uses SQLAlchemy for database interactions and includes security functions for authentication.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema representing user data sent in responses, including ID, email, preferences, and bookmarks.

methods.name: UserOut _user_to_out(u: User)
methods.description: Converts a User model instance into a UserOut schema, parsing JSON fields for bookmarks and preferences.

methods.name: register(payload: UserRegisterIn)
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user; creates user record with hashed password.

methods.name: login(payload: UserLoginIn)
methods.description: Endpoint for user login; verifies credentials and returns an access token.

methods.name: get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"))
methods.description: Retrieves user profile data by user ID.

methods.name: patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates user profile information, including preferences and bookmarks.

methods.name: update_preferences(payload: Dict[str, Any], user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates user preferences with provided data.

ctags.name: get_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_profile(id: int = Path(..., description="User ID")):$/

ctags.name: patch_profile
ctags.pattern: /^async def patch_profile(id: int, payload: UserProfileUpdateIn, user=Depends(get_current_user)):$/
